title: VTN Memberships — Join — payload
description: Accept a parent network's listing of this network: register this network's groups for the parent's roles, then acknowledge the parent's membership offer. The outer document members are owned by the framework — SPEC §6.3.

url.description: The parent network's base URL, as the parent's administrators gave it. Where it is reached, not who it is.

network.description: The parent network's DID. This network refuses if the network found at `url` answers as another DID.

roles.description: Which of this network's roles serves each parent role. A role the parent requires that is not mapped is served by this network's role of the same name.

Response.title: VTN Memberships — Join — response payload
Response.description: The membership as it now stands.

membership.description: This network's membership of the parent as it now stands.
